replies: Ah, a traveller. Forgive me if I stay still. These wounds are making today a long one.
Hello there. I could use a meal before another day of work. Have you come far?
{player}! Good to see a familiar face in {town}. Come, tell me how the road has treated you.
Welcome to {town}. I am {name}. What brings you this way?
A new face! I am {name}. If you need a moment off the road, I have time to talk.
